title: Vesper and the Verdict
author: Oscar Reyes
blurb: Sebastian Vane, an estate lawyer reading a will that shouldn't exist, thought they had seen every way a life can end. Then twin letters arrive: one confessing, one promising more — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must close the one case everyone swore was closed for good, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
